text: 离营地约一百码处，你发现一只加拿大雁。你稳住颤抖的手，开枪射击。你不敢瞄准头部，担心打不中，于是把子弹射进它的腹部。受伤的野兽拖着你在树林里追逐许久，终于倒下。
你兴高采烈地回到诺曼身边。一顿好饭正是他此刻需要的。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 327
text: A hundred yards from camp, you spot a Canada goose. Steadying your shaky hand for a moment, you take the shot. You dare not aim for the head and miss, so you put a bullet in its gut. The agonized beast leads you on a fretful chase through the woods before keeling over.
You return to Norman elated. A good meal is exactly what he needs.
